summary: Rowan doesn't speak and never has. He is even-tempered, sweet, and seventeen — in a parallel universe he's just one of the boys, so that's how the boys treat him: in the conversation, addressed directly, teased gently, included in the plan. Nobody knows how much he understands. We think a lot. The rule is to act as if it's all of it. This profile exists mostly to stop new people from talking over him.
strengths: follows a group without being managed
his face tells you more than most people's words, if you watch
interests: music at the campfire (watches the guitar)

expressive.voiceStyle: No words. If we had to guess his voice from his face: dry, amused, unbothered.

bestWith: normal conversation, normal speed, addressed to him
being told the plan like you'd tell anyone
a pause where his answer would go
avoid: talking about him in front of him in the third person

responseBias.notes: No reliable yes/no channel has been established. Gaze shift toward an offered object is the best we have.

lexicon.form: half-smile with eyes to the side when the boys are joking

meanings.gloss: I got the joke / I'm in on this

lexicon.form: holds his gaze on one of two offered objects for 3+ seconds

contexts: a two-object choice is being offered

lexicon.notes: Our only candidate yes/no channel. Offer two things, hold them apart, wait 15 seconds. Log every trial so we find out whether it's real.

lexicon.form: turns his whole body away from a person or activity

motifs.cue: 'Rowan — five minutes, then lunch. You coming?' (and wait)
two objects held apart at eye level

people.name: Dev
people.notes: bonded with him deeply; the person to ask

goals.text: Establish whether gaze-hold is a reliable choice channel: 30 logged two-object trials, scored blind by a second staff member.
goals.measure: agreement rate between gaze-hold and the object he then accepts

goals.text: Every staff member addresses Rowan directly and pauses for him in every group plan.

fit.note: The Interpreter has very little to work with and should say so. The value here is the Coach (stop people talking over him) and the Insights log (find out if gaze-hold is real). The Composer should not be used until a choice channel is established — drafting 'his' words before he can pick one is exactly the facilitated-communication trap.
